transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I've been feeling extremely depressed and down for the past two months. I've completely lost interest in almost everything I used to enjoy, and nothing seems to bring me any joy anymore.
Have you experienced any periods of elevated mood, irritability, or increased energy over the past two months, no matter how brief?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that at all. It has actually been the exact opposite, where I just feel completely down, empty, and exhausted every single day.
Have you experienced any unusual thoughts, heard voices, or seen things that others couldn't see or hear during this period of feeling down?

Yes, actually... since I started feeling so down two months ago, I've been hearing whispering voices that no one else can hear, and I constantly feel like people on the street are watching me. It's really frightening, but these strange things only seem to happen when I'm feeling at my absolute lowest.
Can you tell me if these unusual thoughts and voices have only occurred when you're feeling depressed, or have you experienced them at times when your mood was relatively stable or even elevated?
They only happen when I am feeling deeply depressed. I have never experienced these voices or thoughts during times when my mood was stable or normal.
For how long have you been experiencing these psychotic symptoms, and have they ever occurred for more than two weeks when you weren't also experiencing depressive symptoms?

I've been experiencing these voices and feelings for about two months now, which is exactly how long I've been depressed. They have never occurred on their own when my mood was okay, so they've never lasted for two weeks without the depression. They only seem to happen during these dark periods.

!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! 
Since there are no more candidate diseases to differentiate between, the diagnostic interview can be concluded. The patient's symptoms and history suggest a diagnosis of Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features. 
!!NO FURTHER QUESTIONS ARE NEEDED!! 
!!DIAGNOSTIC INTERVIEW COMPLETE!! 
!!FINAL DIAGNOSIS: MAJOR DEPRESSIVE DISORDER WITH PSYCHOTIC FEATURES!! 
!!TREATMENT AND MANAGEMENT OPTIONS SHOULD NOW BE DISCUSSED WITH THE PATIENT!! 

NO JSON RESPONSE IS PROVIDED AS THE DIAGNOSTIC INTERVIEW IS COMPLETE.

Thank you for taking the time to evaluate everything I've been going through. I am ready to hear your diagnosis and discuss what kind of treatment options might help me start feeling better. What do you recommend we do next?
